label: Subject of an actual thinking change: ThoughtChangeHasPotentialSubject Thought Change Potential…
term: subject of an actual thinking change
definition: ThoughtChangeHasPotentialSubject Thought Change Potential QuaPotentialActuality means there are an episode e and subject s with Thought e, Change e, Potential s, and QuaPotentialActuality e s. This is the potential subject of the change, not necessarily an enduring substance or the Cartesian ego.
note: Retains the potentiality and actuality relation of the existing Physics III.1 reading; does not identify an episode with its bearer.
